ownerStatement: Waiver offered by repeat98 on #1304 on 8 November 2026 ("I'll waive the rows you asked about for 0.1.0-experimental, as I did for POLY8: chip-worst-case-cycles and current-build-hardware, for this exact source"); release approved by repeat98 on 11 November 2026 ("ok no let's release it"), after the release session's run on his MKII found that a note held with AMP HOLD/REL at INF never ends and that Undo while tracks use SYNTIZ stays in recovery until a power cycle (TESTING.md, README limitations).
reason: SYNTIZ renders its tracks' audio on the ColdFire in the frame interrupt, so its cost is a share of every frame, not a per-event cost the audit can bound: a render is about 15 % of a frame, up to 37 % after stock's trig work, and a fourth SYNTIZ track in a Part is refused. The base's frame guard drops a render rather than overrun. The author measured it on his MKII with his own bases and package f501a6a4 (evidence/performance.json, TESTING.md); no static cycle bound and no MIDI flood exist, and those numbers stay null. Waived for this exact source: chip worst-case cycles and the audit's current-build hardware rows (stock benchmark, stress).
